name: Agilent Technologies
description: Agilent sells the instruments, software, services and consumables a laboratory needs to analyse samples: liquid and gas chromatography, mass spectrometry, spectroscopy, cell analysis, genomics and pathology reagents. Its biggest segment, CrossLab (42% of FY2025 revenue), sells no new analytical instruments; it earns repeat money from service contracts, repairs and consumables such as chromatography columns and lab supplies, mostly vendor-neutral. Customers are pharmaceutical and biopharma firms, diagnostics labs, academic and government labs, and applied markets such as food, environmental and chemicals testing. It also runs a contract manufacturer (CDMO) of oligonucleotide drug ingredients inside Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, which dragged gross margin in FY2025. The June 2026 purchase of Biocare for $950 million adds pathology products.

employees.note: About 7,100 in the Americas, 4,400 in Europe, 6,600 in Asia Pacific.

businessLines.name: Agilent CrossLab
businessLines.how: Recurring: service contracts, repairs, parts, installation and compliance work on lab instruments (Agilent and other makers), plus consumables (GC and LC columns, sample prep, lab supplies) bought repeatedly and mostly vendor-neutral; also lab software and automation.

businessLines.name: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets
businessLines.how: Sells liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry instruments, cell analysis platforms, genomics and pathology reagents and companion diagnostics to pharma, clinical and research labs (one-time instrument sale, then reagents and consumables), plus contract manufacture of oligonucleotide active ingredients for drugmakers.

businessLines.name: Applied Markets
businessLines.how: Sells gas chromatography, GC-MS, atomic and molecular spectroscopy and vacuum instruments and software one-time to food, environmental, chemicals, energy and forensics testing labs.

brands.name: None broken out
brands.note: Agilent sells under its own name; the 10-K gives no separate brand revenue.

brands.name: BC Midco I, Inc. (Biocare)
brands.note: Acquired 2026-06-24 for net consideration of $950 million; clinical and research pathology solutions; included in Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets. Revenue not read.
